# Persisted compatibility fixtures

`s3db-v21-filesystem` was generated by the unmodified `s3db.js` repository at
commit `8264a009ce46b6f5b6e8a30a8916e9608fbffc11` (package version 21.6.2), using
its `FileSystemClient`. It covers the `s3db.json` manifest, stable schema indexes,
metadata-only documents, a body-only document, and partition index objects.

Compatibility tests copy the fixture before opening it and compare every file hash
after disconnect, so a successful read cannot hide an on-disk migration.
